_conventions: origin on the ground at the footprint's centre, +X the front, Z up. expect = bounding box x, y, z in metres, tol 5%. Generic only: no logos, badges, plates. Per-yard colours via slots Plastic, Canvas, Paint (per-instance colour at integration).
_placement: sparse (Bean, Oct 16 2026): by seed per lot from the houses bake, 0-4 props a lot, weighted by lot kind (lawn to the water, dock, pool). Track I writes the rule; Medium gets the dock props only.
